name: dev-diagram-kit
description: 26 skills for developers doing BA work: diagrams (sequence, activity Mermaid/PlantUML/D2, BPMN 2.0, state, ERD Mermaid/D2/DBML, use case, architecture, system-design C4, data-flow DFD, mindmap, journey, timeline, org chart + draw.io cloud architecture with real AWS/Azure/GCP/Databricks stencils) + code-flow (trace one function/module into a flow diagram with code provenance) + scan-project (reverse-engineer a diagram set from the codebase) + diagram (router that picks the right diagram) + gallery (one-file tabbed HTML deck) + sync-confluence (sync code/conversation to Confluence). Unified diagram-validate gate across all engines. Bilingual EN/VI, with automatic compile-check + render + offline PlantUML.
